conciseDescription: Creates a level 1...17 shambling horror. When the shambling horror dies, it is replaced by a level 0...15 jagged horror that causes Bleeding with each of its attacks. <gray>Exploits a fresh corpse.</gray>

name: Order of Undeath
description: For 5 seconds, your minions deal +3...16 damage, but you lose 2% of your maximum Health whenever one of your minions hits with an attack.
conciseDescription: (5 seconds.) Your undead servants deal +3...16 damage. <gray>You lose 2% of your maximum Health whenever your servants hit.</gray>

name: Putrid Flesh
description: Destroy one of your target animated undead minions. All foes near that creature are Diseased for 5...15 seconds.
conciseDescription: Destroys one of your undead servants. Inflicts Diseased condition (5...15 seconds) to foes near this servant.

name: Feast for the Dead
description: Destroy target animated undead ally. All of your other animated undead allies are healed for 10...100 Health.
conciseDescription: Destroys one of your undead servants. Heals your servants for 10...100.

name: Jagged Bones
description: For 60 seconds, whenever target undead servant dies, it is replaced by a level 0...15 jagged horror that causes Bleeding with each of its attacks.
conciseDescription: (60 seconds.) When target undead servant dies, it is replaced by a level 0...15 jagged horror that inflicts Bleeding with attacks.

name: Contagion
description: For 60 seconds, whenever you suffer from a new condition, all foes in the area suffer from that same condition and you sacrifice 10...5% maximum Health.
conciseDescription: (60 seconds.) Whenever you gain a condition, all foes in the area gain that same condition. <gray>You sacrifice 10...5% maximum Health each time this happens.</gray>

name: Ulcerous Lungs
description: For 10...25 seconds, target foe and all nearby foes suffer from -4 Health degeneration when Bleeding, and whenever they use a shout or chant, they Bleed for 3...15 seconds.
conciseDescription: Also hexes foes near your target (10...25 seconds). Causes -4 Health degeneration to any of these foes that are Bleeding. Inflicts Bleeding (3...15 seconds) whenever these foes use a shout or chant.

name: Pain of Disenchantment
description: Target foe loses 1...3 enchantment[s]. If an enchantment was lost in this way, that foe and all adjacent foes lose 10...100 Health.
conciseDescription: Target foe loses 1...3 enchantment[s]. Removal effect: that foe and all adjacent foes lose 10...100 Health.

name: Mark of Fury
description: For 5 seconds, allies hitting target foe gain 0...2 strike[s] of adrenaline. When this hex ends, that foe suffers from Cracked Armor for 1...15 second[s].
conciseDescription: (5 seconds.) Allies hitting target foe gain 0...2 strike[s] of adrenaline. End effect: inflicts Cracked Armor (1...15 second[s].)

name: Corrupt Enchantment
description: Remove one enchantment from target foe. If an enchantment is removed in this way, that foe suffers from -1...8 Health degeneration for 10 seconds.
conciseDescription: Removes one enchantment from target foe. Removal effect: -1...8 Health degeneration (10 seconds).

name: Signet of Sorrow
description: Target foe takes 15...75 damage. If target foe is near a corpse or has a dead pet, this skill recharges instantly.
conciseDescription: Deals 15...75 damage. Recharges instantly if target foe is near a corpse or has a dead pet.

name: Signet of Suffering
description: You suffer from Bleeding for 6 seconds. The next Necromancer skill that targets a foe causes Bleeding for 2...16 seconds.
conciseDescription: You Bleed for 6 seconds. Applies Bleeding (2...16 seconds) to the target of your next Necromancer skill.

name: Signet of Lost Souls
description: If target foe is below 50% Health, you gain 10...100 Health and 1...10 Energy.
conciseDescription: You gain 10...100 Health and 1...10 Energy if target foe is below 50% Health.

name: Well of Darkness
description: Exploit nearest corpse or sacrifice 66% health to create a Well of Darkness for 5...50 seconds. Hexed foes within the Well of Darkness miss 50% of the time.
conciseDescription: (5...50 seconds.) Hexed foes in this well have 50% chance to miss. <gray>Exploits a fresh corpse or sacrifices 66% health</gray>.

name: Blinding Surge
description: Target foe is struck for 5...50 lightning damage. That foe and all adjacent foes are Blinded for 3...8 seconds. This spell has 25% armor penetration. If this spell strikes an attacking foe, all adjacent foes are also struck and this spell deals 50% more damage.
conciseDescription: Deals 5...50 lightning damage. Inflicts Blindness condition (3...8 seconds) on target and adjacent foes. 25% armor penetration. If target was attacking, also hits adjacent foes and deals 50% more damage.

name: Chilling Winds
description: Target foe and all adjacent foes are struck for 30...60 cold damage. For 10 seconds, the next Water Magic hex targeting a hexed foe lasts 25...100% longer.
conciseDescription: (10 seconds.) The next water hex on target foe lasts 25...100% longer. Initial effect: 30...60 cold damage. Also strikes adjacent.

name: Lightning Bolt
description: Send out a Lightning Bolt that strikes for 5...50 lightning damage if it hits. If Lightning Bolt strikes a moving foe, that foe is struck for 5...50 additional lightning damage. This spell has 25% armor penetration.
conciseDescription: Projectile: deals 5...50 lightning damage. Deals 5...50 more lightning damage if target foe is moving. 25% armor penetration.

name: Storm Djinn's Haste
description: For 10...25 seconds, you move 25% faster. Each second that you are moving, you lose 1 Energy.
conciseDescription: (10...25 seconds.) You move 25% faster. <gray>Lose 1 Energy each second while moving.</gray>

name: Stone Striker
description: For 5...30 seconds, whenever you take or deal elemental or physical damage, that damage is converted to earth damage.
conciseDescription: (5...30 seconds.) Converts elemental and physical damage you take or deal to earth damage.

name: Sandstorm
description: Create a Sandstorm at target foe's location. For 10 seconds, nearby foes are struck for 20...40 earth damage each second and attacking foes are struck for an additional 10...30 earth damage each second.
conciseDescription: Deals 20...40 earth damage each second (10 seconds). Hits foes near target foe's initial location. Hits attacking foes for 10...30 more earth damage each second.

name: Stone Sheath
description: For 5...20 seconds, you and target ally have +1...30 armor and are immune to critical hits. When you cast this spell, all foes near you and your target take 15...70 earth damage and are Weakened for 5...20 seconds.
conciseDescription: (5...20 seconds.) Gives you and target ally +1...30 armor and immunity to critical hits. Initial effect: Foes near you and target ally are struck for 15...70 earth damage and are Weakened (5...20 seconds).

name: Ebon Hawk
description: Send a projectile that strikes target foe for 10...85 earth damage and causes Weakness for 5...15 seconds if it hits.
conciseDescription: Projectile: deals 10...85 earth damage and inflicts Weakness condition (5...15 seconds).

name: Stoneflesh Aura
description: For 5...15 seconds, damage you receive is reduced by 1...31, and you are immune to critical attacks.
conciseDescription: (5...15 seconds.) Reduces damage you take by 1...31, and you are immune to critical hits.

name: Glyph of Restoration
description: For 15 seconds, your next 2 spells heal you for 30...105 Health, and you are healed for 150...400% of the Energy cost of each spell.
conciseDescription: (15 seconds.) Your next 2 spells heal you for 30...105, and you are healed for 150...400% of the Energy cost of each spell.

name: Ether Prism
description: For 3 seconds, all damage you take is reduced by 75%. When Ether Prism ends, you gain 5...20 Energy.
conciseDescription: (3 seconds.) All damage you take is reduced by 75%. End effect: gain 5...20 Energy.

name: Master of Magic
description: For 1...61 second[s], all of your elemental attributes are set to 8...14 and your elemental spells return 30% of their Energy cost.
conciseDescription: (1...61 second[s]). Your elemental attributes are set to 8...14 and elemental spells return 30% of their Energy cost.

name: Glowing Gaze
description: Target foe takes 5...50 fire damage. If that foe is on Fire, <sic/> you gain 5 Energy plus 1 Energy for every 2 ranks of Energy Storage.
conciseDescription: Deals 5...50 fire damage. You gain 5 Energy plus 1 Energy for every 2 ranks of Energy Storage if target foe is Burning.

name: Savannah Heat
description: You create Savannah Heat at target foe's location. For 5 seconds, all nearby foes take 5...20 fire damage for each second this spell has been in effect.
conciseDescription: Deals 5...20 fire damage for each second since casting this spell (5 seconds). <gray>Hits foes near target's initial location.</gray>

name: Flame Djinn's Haste
description: All adjacent foes are struck for 15...120 fire damage. For 8...14 seconds, you move 25% faster. Flame Djinn's Haste recharges 50% faster if a foe was struck by this spell.
conciseDescription: (8...14 seconds.) You move 25% faster. Initial effect: deals 15...120 fire damage to foes adjacent to you. If you damage a foe with this spell, it recharges 50% faster.

name: Freezing Gust
description: If target foe is under the effect of a Water Magic hex, that foe is struck for 20...80 cold damage. Otherwise, that foe moves 66% slower for 1...5 second[s].
conciseDescription: Deals 20...80 cold damage if target foe is hexed with Water Magic. Otherwise, this foe moves 66% slower (1...5 second[s]).

name: Judge's Intervention
description: For 10 seconds, the next time target ally receives damage that would be fatal, the damage is negated and one nearby foe takes 30...180 holy damage.
conciseDescription: (10 seconds.) Negates the next fatal damage. Negation effect: deals 30...180 holy damage to one foe near target ally.

name: Supportive Spirit
description: For 5...23 seconds, whenever target ally takes damage while knocked down, that ally is healed for 5...50 Health.
conciseDescription: (5...23 seconds.) Heals for 5...50 whenever target ally takes damage while knocked-down.

name: Watchful Healing
description: For 10 seconds, target ally gains +1...4 Health regeneration. If this skill ends prematurely, that ally gains 30...120 Health.
conciseDescription: (10 seconds.) Target ally has +1...4 Health regeneration and gains 30...120 Health if this enchantment ends early.

name: Healer's Boon
description: For 10...55 seconds. <sic/> Healing Prayers spells cast 50% faster and heal for 50% more Health.
conciseDescription: (10...55 seconds.) Healing Prayers spells cast 50% faster and heal for 50% more.

name: Healer's Covenant
description: While you maintain this enchantment, your Healing Prayers spells heal for 20% less Health, but cost -1...4 Energy.
conciseDescription: Your Healing Prayers spells cost 1...4 less Energy. <gray>These spells heal for 20% less.</gray>

name: Balthazar's Pendulum
description: For 5...25 seconds, the next time target ally would be knocked down by a foe, that foe is knocked down instead.
conciseDescription: (5...25 seconds.) Causes knock-down to the next foe attempting to knock-down target ally.

name: Words of Comfort
description: Target ally is healed for 15...60 Health and an additional 15...45 Health if that ally is suffering from a condition.
conciseDescription: Heals for 15...60. Heals for 15...45 more if target ally has a condition.

name: Light of Deliverance
description: All party members are healed for 5...70 Health.
conciseDescription: Heals entire party for 5...70.

name: Scourge Enchantment
description: For 30 seconds, each time target foe is the target of an enchantment, the caster of that enchantment takes 15...75 damage.
conciseDescription: (30 seconds.) Deals 15...75 damage to anyone casting an enchantment on target foe.

name: Shield of Absorption
description: For 3...7 seconds, damage received by target ally is reduced by 5 each time that ally is hit while under the effects of this enchantment.
conciseDescription: (3...7 seconds.) Reduces incoming damage by 5 each time target ally takes damage.

name: Reversal of Damage
description: For 8 seconds, the next time target ally would take damage, the foe dealing the damage takes that damage instead (maximum 5...75).
conciseDescription: (8 seconds.) Negates the next damage and hits the source for that same amount (maximum 5...75).

name: Mending Touch
description: Touched ally loses two conditions and is healed for 15...60 Health for each condition removed in this way.
conciseDescription: Touch Spell. Removes two conditions. Heals for 15...60 for each condition removed.

name: Critical Chop
description: If this attack hits, you inflict +5...20 damage. If this attack results in a critical hit, target foe is interrupted.
conciseDescription: Deals +5...20 damage. Interrupts an action if you land a critical hit.

name: Agonizing Chop
description: When this attack hits, you deal +5...20 damage. If target foe is suffering from a Deep Wound, you interrupt that foe's action.
conciseDescription: Deals +5...20 damage. Interrupts an action if target foe has a Deep Wound.

name: Flail
description: For 1...15 second[s], you attack 33% faster but move 33% slower.
conciseDescription: (1...15 second[s].) You attack 33% faster. <gray>You move 33% slower.</gray>

name: Charging Strike
description: For 1...10 second[s], you run 33% faster. Your next successful melee hit does +10...90 damage and this stance ends. This stance ends if you use a skill.
conciseDescription: (1...10 second[s].) You move 33% faster and deal +10...90 damage with your next melee hit. <gray>Ends when you hit or if you use a skill.</gray>

name: Headbutt
description: Target touched foe takes 40...100 damage. You are Dazed for 10 seconds.
conciseDescription: Elite Touch Skill. Deals 40...100 damage. <gray>You are Dazed (10 seconds).</gray>

name: Lion's Comfort
description: All of your signets are disabled for 12 seconds. You are healed for 50...110 Health, and gain 0...3 strike[s] of adrenaline.
conciseDescription: You are healed for 50...110 and gain 0...3 strike[s] of adrenaline. <gray>Disables your signets (12 seconds).</gray>

name: Rage of the Ntouka
description: Gain 1...7 strike[s] of adrenaline. For 8 seconds, whenever you use an adrenal skill, that skill recharges for 3 seconds.
conciseDescription: You gain 1...7 adrenaline. <gray>For 8 seconds, adrenal skills have a 3 second recharge when used.</gray>

name: Mokele Smash
description: If this attack hits, you strike for +5...20 damage and gain 2 strikes of adrenaline.
conciseDescription: Deals +5...20 damage and you gain 2 strikes of adrenaline.

name: Overbearing Smash
description: If this attack hits, you deal +1...20 damage. If target foe is knocked down, that foe is Dazed for 1...8 second[s].
conciseDescription: Deals +1...20 damage. If target foe is knocked down, they are Dazed (1...8 second[s]).

name: Signet of Stamina
description: You have +50...300 maximum Health. This signet ends if you successfully hit with an attack.
conciseDescription: You have +50...300 maximum Health. <gray>Ends if you hit with an attack.</gray>

name: "You're All Alone!"
description: If target foe isn't near an ally, that foe suffers from Cripple and Weakness for 8 seconds.
conciseDescription: Inflicts Cripple and Weakness conditions (8 seconds). <gray>No effect if target foe is near one of its allies.</gray>

name: Burst of Aggression
description: For 2...10 seconds, you attack 33% faster. When this stance ends, you lose all adrenaline.
conciseDescription: (2...10 seconds.) You attack 33% faster. <gray>End effect: lose all adrenaline.</gray>

name: Enraging Charge
description: For 5...15 seconds, you move 25% faster. Enraging Charge ends when you successfully strike a target, at which point you gain 0...3 strike[s] of adrenaline if you hit with a melee attack.
conciseDescription: (5...15 seconds.) You move 25% faster. Gain +0...3 adrenaline on your next melee attack. <gray>Ends after your next hit.</gray>

name: Crippling Slash
description: If this attack hits, target foe is Crippled for 5...15 seconds and begins Bleeding for 10...25 seconds.
conciseDescription: Inflicts Crippled condition (5...15 seconds) and Bleeding condition (10...25 seconds).

name: Barbarous Slice
description: If this attack hits, you deal +5...30 damage. If you are currently not in a stance, you also inflict Bleeding for 5...15 seconds.
conciseDescription: Deals +5...30 damage. Inflicts Bleeding condition (5...15 seconds) if you are not in a stance.

name: Prepared Shot
description: If this attack hits, you strike for +10...25 damage. If you are under the effects of a preparation, you gain 1...9 Energy.
conciseDescription: Deals +10...25 damage. You gain 1...9 Energy if you have a preparation active.

name: Burning Arrow
description: If this attack hits, you strike for +10...30 damage and cause Burning for 1...7 seconds.
conciseDescription: Deals +10...30 damage. Inflicts Burning condition (1...7 seconds).

name: Arcing Shot
description: If this arrow hits, it strikes for +10...35 damage. This arrow cannot be blocked, but it moves 50% slower.
conciseDescription: Deals +10...35 damage. Unblockable. <gray>This arrow moves 50% slower.</gray>

name: Strike as One
description: Your animal companion instantly moves to your target and causes Bleeding for 5...15 seconds with its next attack. The next time you hit with an attack, target foe is Crippled for 5...15 seconds.
conciseDescription: Your animal companion instantly moves to your target and inflicts Bleeding (5...15 seconds) with its next attack. The next time you hit with an attack, you inflict Crippled condition (5...15 seconds).

name: Crossfire
description: If this attack hits target foe, it deals +5...20 damage. If that foe is near any of your allies, this attack cannot be blocked.
conciseDescription: Deals +5...20 damage. Unblockable if target foe is near any of your allies.

name: Barbed Arrows
description: For 24 seconds, your arrows cause Bleeding for 3...15 seconds. You have -40 armor while activating this skill.
conciseDescription: (24 seconds.) Your arrows inflict Bleeding condition (3...15 seconds). <gray>You have -40 armor while activating this skill.</gray>

name: Scavenger's Focus
description: For 10 seconds if you strike a foe who is suffering from a condition you gain 3...12 Energy.
conciseDescription: (10 seconds). You gain 3...12 Energy if you strike a foe who has a condition.

name: Toxicity
description: Create a level 1...10 spirit. Poisoned or Diseased creatures within its range suffer -2 Health degeneration. This spirit dies after 30...180 seconds.
conciseDescription: Creates a level 1...10 spirit (30...180 second lifespan.) Poisoned or Diseased creatures within range have -2 Health degeneration.

name: Quicksand
description: Create a level 1...10 spirit. All non-spirit creatures within its range lose 1 Energy each time they attack or use a skill. This spirit dies after 30...180 seconds.
conciseDescription: Creates a level 1...10 spirit (30...180 second lifespan). Creatures lose 1 Energy each time they attack or use a skill. Does not affect spirits.

name: Storm's Embrace
description: For 10 seconds, you move 25% faster. This stance is refreshed whenever you take Elemental damage.
conciseDescription: (10 seconds.) You move 25% faster. Renewal: whenever you take elemental damage.

name: Trapper's Speed
description: For 5...30 seconds, your Traps recharge 25% faster and activate 25% faster. This Stance ends if you successfully hit with an attack.
conciseDescription: (5...30 seconds.) Your traps recharge 25% faster and activate 25% faster. <gray>Ends if you hit with an attack.</gray>

name: Tripwire
description: When Tripwire is triggered, all nearby foes are struck for 5...20 piercing damage. Any Crippled foes are knocked down. Tripwire ends after 90 seconds. While activating this skill, you are easily interrupted.
conciseDescription: (90 seconds.) Deals 5...20 piercing damage to nearby foes. Causes knock-down to Crippled foes. <gray>Easily interrupted.</gray>

name: Renewing Surge
description: For 8 seconds, target foe suffers 2...12 damage each second. When this hex ends, you gain 1...8 Energy.
conciseDescription: (8 seconds.) Deals 2...12 damage each second. End effect: You gain 1...8 energy.

name: Offering of Spirit
description: Gain 8...17 Energy. If any spirits are within earshot, you do not sacrifice Health.
conciseDescription: You gain 8...17 Energy. You do not sacrifice Health if any spirits are within earshot.

name: Spirit's Gift
description: For 60 seconds, whenever you create a creature, all allies near that creature gain 5...50 Health and lose 1 condition.
conciseDescription: (60 seconds.) Whenever you create a creature, all nearby allies gain 5...50 Health and lose one condition.

name: Death Pact Signet
description: Resurrect target party member with your current Health and 15...100% Energy. The next time that ally dies within 120 seconds, so do you.
conciseDescription: Resurrects target party member with your current Health and 15...100% maximum Energy. <gray>For 120 seconds, you die the next time this party member dies.</gray>

name: Reclaim Essence
description: All of your Spirits die. You gain 5...20 Energy and all of your Binding Rituals are recharged if a Spirit died in this way.
conciseDescription: All of your Spirits die. If a Spirit dies in this way, you gain 5...20 Energy and all of your Binding Rituals are recharged.

name: Banishing Strike
description: If it hits, this attack deals 10...60 holy damage. It deals double damage to summoned creatures.
conciseDescription: Deals 10...60 holy damage. Deals double damage to summoned creatures.

name: Mystic Sweep
description: If this attack hits, you deal +3...12 damage. If you are enchanted, this attack deals an additional +3...12 damage.
conciseDescription: Deals +3...12 damage. Deals an additional +3...12 damage if you are enchanted.

name: Eremite's Attack
description: If it hits, this attack deals +1...10 damage and removes a Dervish enchantment. If an enchantment is removed, you do an additional +1...10 damage and strike all adjacent foes.
conciseDescription: Deals +1...10 damage and removes a Dervish enchantment. Removal Effect: Deals +1...10 damage and strikes all adjacent foes.

name: Reap Impurities
description: If this attack hits, you deal +3...15 damage. Each foe you hit loses 1 condition. For each foe who loses a condition, all foes adjacent to that target foe take 10...40 holy damage.
conciseDescription: Deals +3...15 damage. Struck foes lose 1 condition. Removal Effect: all foes adjacent to those struck take 10...40 holy damage.

name: Twin Moon Sweep
description: You lose 1 Dervish enchantment and gain 10...50 Health. If an enchantment is lost in this way, you cannot be blocked, you strike twice, and you gain an additional 10...70 Health.
conciseDescription: Remove 1 of your Dervish enchantments. Gain 10...50 Health. Removal effect: unblockable, attack twice, and gain 10...70 more Health.

name: Victorious Sweep
description: If this attack hits, you deal +5...25 damage. If target foe has less Health than you, you gain 30...80 Health.
conciseDescription: Deals +5...25 damage. You gain 30...80 Health for each foe you hit that has less Health than you.

name: Irresistible Sweep
description: Deal +3...15 damage and lose 1 Dervish enchantment. If you lose an enchantment in this way, Irresistible Sweep cannot be blocked, removes a stance, and deals +3...15 additional damage.
conciseDescription: Deals +3...15 damage. Remove 1 of your Dervish enchantments. Removal effect: unblockable, removes a stance, deals +3...15 additional damage.

name: Pious Assault
description: If it hits, this attack deals +10...20 damage and removes 1 Dervish enchantment. If a Dervish enchantment was removed, this skill recharges 75% faster and adjacent foes take 15...40 damage.
conciseDescription: Deals +10...20 damage. Removes 1 of your Dervish enchantments. Removal Effect: this skill recharges 75% faster and adjacent foes take 15...40 damage.

name: Mystic Twister
description: Deals 10...60 cold damage to all nearby foes. If you are enchanted, this spell deals an additional 10...60 cold damage.
conciseDescription: Deals 10...60 cold damage to all nearby foes. Deals 10...60 more cold damage if you are enchanted.

name: Grenth's Fingers
description: All nearby foes are struck for 10...40 cold damage. For 30 seconds, your attacks deal cold damage. When this enchantment ends, you transfer 1...2 condition[s] to all nearby foes. <sic/>
conciseDescription: (30 seconds.) Your attacks deal cold damage. Initial effect: hits nearby foes for 10...40 cold damage. End effect: transfers 1...2 condition[s] to all nearby foes.

name: Aura of Thorns
description: All nearby foes begin Bleeding for 5...15 seconds. For 30 seconds, this enchantment does nothing. When this enchantment ends, all nearby foes are Crippled for 3...8 seconds.
conciseDescription: (30 seconds.) Initial effect: inflicts Bleeding condition (5...15 seconds) on nearby foes. End effect: inflicts Crippled condition (3...8 seconds) on nearby foes.

name: Balthazar's Rage
description: All nearby foes are set on fire for 1...3 second[s]. For 20 seconds afterward, this enchantment does nothing. When this enchantment ends, you gain 1...2 strike[s] of adrenaline if any foes are within earshot.
conciseDescription: (20 seconds.) Initial Effect: Inflicts burning (1...3 second[s]) on nearby foes. End effect: gain 1...2 strike[s] of adrenaline if any foes are within earshot.

name: Dust Cloak
description: All nearby foes are struck for 10...40 earth damage. For 30 seconds, your attacks deal earth damage. When this enchantment ends, all nearby foes are Blinded for 1...4 second[s].
conciseDescription: (30 seconds.) Your attacks deal earth damage. Initial effect: deals 10...40 earth damage to nearby foes. End effect: inflicts Blindness condition (1...4 second[s]) on nearby foes.

name: Staggering Force
description: All nearby foes are struck for 10...40 earth damage. For 30 seconds, your attacks deal earth damage. When this enchantment ends, all nearby foes have Cracked Armor for 1...10 second[s].
conciseDescription: (30 seconds.) Your attacks deal earth damage. Initial effect: deals 10...40 earth damage to nearby foes. End effect: inflicts Cracked Armor condition (1...10 second[s]) on nearby foes.

name: Pious Renewal
description: For 8 seconds, nothing happens. When this enchantment ends, Pious Renewal is recharged and you gain 0...5 Energy and 0...30 Health.
conciseDescription: (8 seconds.) End Effect: recharges itself and you gain 0...5 Energy and 0...30 Health.

name: Mirage Cloak
description: For 1...7 second[s], you have a 30...60% chance to block incoming attacks. When you cast this enchantment, all nearby foes are struck for 10...40 earth damage.
conciseDescription: (1...7 second[s].) You have 30...60% chance to block. Initial Effect: deals 10...40 earth damage to nearby foes.

name: Arcane Zeal
description: For 10 seconds, whenever you cast a spell, you gain 2 Energy for each enchantment on you (maximum 2...7 Energy).
conciseDescription: (10 seconds.) You gain 2 Energy (maximum 2...7) for each enchantment on you whenever you cast a spell.

name: Mystic Vigor
description: For 20 seconds, every time you successfully hit with an attack, you gain 3...15 Health for each enchantment on you (maximum 25 Health).
conciseDescription: (20 seconds.) You gain 3...15 Health (maximum 25) for each enchantment on you whenever you hit with an attack.

name: Watchful Intervention
description: For 60 seconds, the next time damage drops target ally's Health below 25%, that ally is healed for 50...200 Health.
conciseDescription: (60 seconds.) Heals for 50...200 the next time damage drops target ally's Health below 25%.

name: Vow of Piety
description: For 20 seconds, you have +24 armor and +1...4 Health regeneration. Vow of Piety renews whenever an enchantment on you ends.
conciseDescription: (20 seconds) +24 armor and +1...4 Health regeneration. Renewal: Whenever an enchantment on you ends.

name: Vital Boon
description: For 20 seconds, you have +40...100 maximum Health. When this enchantment ends, you are healed for 75...200 Health.
conciseDescription: (20 seconds.) You have +40...100 maximum Health. End effect: Heals you for 75...200.

name: Heart of Holy Flame
description: All nearby foes take 5...30 holy damage. For 30 seconds, your attacks deal holy damage. When this enchantment ends, all nearby foes are set on fire for 2...5 seconds.
conciseDescription: (30 seconds.) Your attacks deal holy damage. Initial effect: deals 5...30 holy damage to nearby foes. End effect: inflicts Burning condition (2...5 seconds) on nearby foes.

name: Extend Enchantments
description: For 10 seconds, your next Dervish enchantment lasts 10...150% longer.
conciseDescription: (10 seconds.) Your next Dervish enchantment lasts 10...150% longer.

name: Faithful Intervention
description: If damage drops your Health below 50%, Faithful Intervention ends. When Faithful Intervention ends, you are healed for 30...150 Health.
conciseDescription: You gain 30...150 Health the next time damage drops your Health below 50%.

name: Sand Shards
description: For 30 seconds, the next 1...5 time[s] you hit with a scythe, all other adjacent foes take 10...60 earth damage.
conciseDescription: (30 seconds.) Deal 10...60 earth damage to all other adjacent foes whenever you hit with your scythe. <gray>Ends after 1...5 hit[s].</gray>

name: Lyssa's Haste
description: For 3...15 seconds, your Dervish enchantments recharge 33% faster. When you activate this enchantment, all adjacent foes are interrupted. When this enchantment ends, all adjacent foes are interrupted. 50% failure chance unless Wind Prayers 5 or higher.
conciseDescription: (3...15 seconds.) Your Dervish enchantments recharge 33% faster. Initial Effect: interrupts all adjacent foes. End Effect: interrupts all adjacent foes. <gray>50% failure chance unless Wind Prayers 5 or higher.</gray>

name: Guiding Hands
description: For 20 seconds, your next 0...3 attack[s] cannot be blocked. When activated, this skill removes the Blindness condition.
conciseDescription: (20 seconds.) Your next 0...3 attack[s] cannot be blocked. Initial effect: removes Blindness.

name: Fleeting Stability
description: For 4...10 seconds, you cannot be knocked down and move 25% faster. This enchantment ends prematurely if it prevents a knockdown.
conciseDescription: (4...10 seconds.) You cannot be knocked down and move 25% faster. Ends if knockdown prevented.

name: Armor of Sanctity
description: All adjacent foes suffer from Weakness for 5...15 seconds. For 15 seconds, you take 5...20 less damage from foes suffering from a condition.
conciseDescription: Inflicts Weakness condition on all adjacent foes (5...15). You take 5...20 less damage from foes with a condition. (15 seconds.)

name: Mystic Regeneration
description: For 5...20 seconds, you have +1...4 Health regeneration for each enchantment (maximum of 8) on you.
conciseDescription: (5...20 seconds.) You have +1...4 Health regeneration for each enchantment (maximum of 8) on you.

name: Vow of Silence
description: For 5...10 seconds, you cannot be the target of spells, and you cannot cast spells.
conciseDescription: (5...10 seconds.) Spells cannot target you. <gray>You cannot cast spells.</gray>

name: Avatar of Balthazar
description: For 10...90 seconds, you gain +20 armor against physical damage, you gain adrenaline 25% faster, your attacks deal holy damage, and whenever you lose a Dervish enchantment, nearby foes are set on fire for 1...3 second[s]. This skill is disabled for 45 seconds.
conciseDescription: (10...90 seconds.) You gain +20 armor against physical damage, you gain adrenaline 25% faster, your attacks deal holy damage, you inflict Burning (1...3 second[s]) on nearby foes whenever you lose a Dervish enchantment. This skill is disabled for 45 seconds.

name: Avatar of Dwayna
description: For 10...90 seconds, your attacks deal holy damage. Whenever you use a Dervish attack skill, you lose 1 hex. Whenever you lose a Dervish enchantment, all allies in earshot are healed for 5...50 Health. This skill is disabled for 45 seconds.
conciseDescription: (10...90 seconds.) You deal holy damage. Whenever you use a Dervish attack skill, you lose 1 hex. Heal allies in earshot for 5...50 Health when you lose a Dervish enchantment. <gray>This skill is disabled for 45 seconds.</gray>

name: Avatar of Grenth
description: For 10...90 seconds, your scythe attacks deal dark damage, and steal 0...12 Health. You are immune to Disease, and inflict Disease on all adjacent foes for 3 seconds whenever you lose a Dervish enchantment. This skill is disabled for 45 seconds.
conciseDescription: (10...90 seconds.) Your scythe attacks deal dark damage and steal 0...12 Health. You are immune to Disease. Apply Disease to all adjacent foes (3 seconds) when you lose a Dervish enchantment. This skill is disabled for 45 seconds.

name: Avatar of Lyssa
description: For 10...90 seconds, your Dervish enchantments recharge 50% faster and your attacks deal chaos damage. Whenever you lose a Dervish enchantment, steal 1 Energy from all nearby foes. This skill is disabled for 45 seconds.
conciseDescription: (10...90 seconds.) Your Dervish enchantments recharge 50% faster and deal chaos damage with attacks. Steal 1 Energy from nearby foes when you lose a Dervish enchantment. This skill is disabled for 45 seconds.

name: Avatar of Melandru
description: For 10...90 seconds, you have +150 Health, +30 elemental armor, and your attacks deal earth damage. Whenever you lose a Dervish enchantment, all party members in earshot lose 1 condition. This skill is disabled for 45 seconds.
conciseDescription: (10...90 seconds.) You have +150 maximum Health, +30 elemental armor, and your attacks deal earth damage. Cure 1 condition from all party members in earshot whenever you lose a Dervish enchantment. <gray>This skill is disabled for 45 seconds.</gray>

name: Meditation
description: Lose all adrenaline. For 20 seconds, you gain 1...4 Energy every time an enchantment on you ends.
conciseDescription: (20 seconds.) <gray>Lose all adrenaline.</gray> Gain 1...4 Energy whenever an enchantment on you ends.

name: Eremite's Zeal
description: You gain 1...3 Energy for each foe within earshot, maximum 8 Energy. For 10 seconds afterward, this enchantment does nothing. When this enchantment ends, you gain 1...3 Energy for each foe within earshot, maximum 8 Energy.
conciseDescription: (10 seconds.) Initial effect: you gain 1...3 Energy (maximum 8) for each foe in earshot. End effect: you gain 1...3 Energy (maximum 8) for each foe in earshot.

name: Natural Healing
description: You are healed for 50...170 Health. If you are not enchanted, this spell activates 50% faster.
conciseDescription: Heals you for 50...170. This skill activates 50% faster if you are not enchanted.

name: Imbue Health
description: Target other ally is healed for 5...50% of your current Health (maximum 300 Health).
conciseDescription: Heals for 5...50% of your current Health (maximum 300). <gray>Cannot self-target.</gray>

name: Mystic Healing
description: You are healed for 5...65 Health. Also heals all enchanted party members for 5...65 Health.
conciseDescription: Heals you for 5...65. Heals all enchanted party members for 5...65 Health.

name: Dwayna's Touch
description: Target touched ally is healed for 60 Health for each Enchantment on you (maximum 60...240).
conciseDescription: Touch Spell. Heals for 60 (maximum 60...240) for each enchantment on you.

name: Pious Restoration
description: You gain 80...150 Health and remove 1 Dervish enchantment. If an enchantment was removed in this way, you also lose 1...3 hex[es].
conciseDescription: Gain 80...150 Health and remove 1 Dervish enchantment. Removal effect: lose 1...3 hex[es].

name: Signet of Pious Light
description: Remove 1 Dervish enchantment. Target ally is healed for 30...150 Health. If an enchantment was removed in this way, this signet recharges 75% faster.
conciseDescription: Heals for 30...150. Removes one of your Dervish enchantments. Removal effect: recharges 75% faster.

name: Intimidating Aura
description: For 60 seconds, you have +40...100 max Health and take 1...10 less damage from foes with less Health than you.
conciseDescription: (60 seconds.) You have +40...100 max Health and take -1...10 damage from foes with less Health than you.

name: Mystic Sandstorm
description: Create a sandstorm at your location that lasts 3 seconds. Each second, foes nearby this location take 10...20 earth damage. Attacking foes take an additional 10...20 damage. If you are enchanted when you cast this spell, it lasts twice as long.
conciseDescription: (3 seconds.) Deals 10...20 earth damage each second. Deals an additional 10...20 damage to attacking foes. Hits foes nearby your initial location. Lasts twice as long if you are enchanted.

name: Winds of Disenchantment
description: Lose 1 Dervish enchantment. If a Dervish enchantment was removed in this way, all nearby foes lose 1 enchantment and take 20...80 cold damage.
conciseDescription: Remove one of your Dervish enchantments. Removal effect: all nearby foes lose 1 enchantment and take 20...80 cold damage.

name: Rending Touch
description: Deals 15...65 cold damage to target foe. You lose one Dervish enchantment. If an enchantment was removed, target foe loses 1 enchantment and you gain 2 strikes of adrenaline.
conciseDescription: Touch Spell. Deals 15...65 cold damage. Lose 1 Dervish enchantment. Removal effect: target foe loses 1 enchantment and you gain 2 strikes of adrenaline.

name: Crippling Sweep
description: If this attack hits a foe, that foe is Crippled for 3...12 seconds. This skill deals +3...15 extra damage if that foe is moving.
conciseDescription: (3...12 seconds.) Inflicts Cripple <sic/> condition. Deals +3...15 damage to moving foes.

name: Wounding Strike
description: If this attack hits, you do +5...20 damage, target foe suffers from Bleeding for 5...20 seconds, and you lose 1 Dervish enchantment. If an enchantment is removed, target foe also suffers from a Deep Wound for 5...20 seconds.
conciseDescription: Deals +5...20 damage and inflicts Bleeding condition (5...20 seconds). Remove 1 Dervish enchantment. Removal Effect: inflicts Deep Wound condition (5...20 seconds).

name: Wearying Strike
description: You remove 1 Dervish enchantment. If an enchantment was removed, you inflict a Deep Wound for 3...10 seconds. You suffer from Weakness for 10 seconds if an enchantment is not removed.
conciseDescription: Remove 1 Dervish Enchantment. Removal Effect: Inflicts Deep Wound condition (3...10 seconds). <gray>You are Weakened (10 seconds) if an enchantment is not lost.</gray>

name: Lyssa's Assault
description: This attack interrupts an action if it hits. If you are enchanted, any skill you interrupt is disabled for additional 1...10 second[s]. This attack does 50% normal damage.
conciseDescription: Interrupts an action. If you are enchanted, the interrupted skill is disabled for an additional 1...10 second[s]. This attack does 50% of normal damage.

name: Chilling Victory
description: If it hits, this attack strikes for +3...15 damage. For each foe hit who has less Health than you, that foe and all adjacent foes are struck for 10...30 cold damage.
conciseDescription: Deals +3...15 damage. Deals 10...30 cold damage to each foe hit who has less Health than you and foes adjacent to those targets.

name: Conviction
description: For 10 seconds, you gain +10 armor if you have a condition and gain 1...3 Health regen <sic/> for each condition you are suffering from. When this enchantment ends, you are cured of 1...2 condition[s].
conciseDescription: (10 seconds.) Gain +10 armor while conditioned. Gain 1...3 Health regeneration for each condition you have. End Effect: Remove 1...2 condition[s].

name: Enchanted Haste
description: For 7 seconds, you move 25% faster. If this enchantment ends prematurely, you lose 1 condition.
conciseDescription: (7 seconds). You move 25% faster. Lose 1 condition if this enchantment ends prematurely.

name: Pious Concentration
description: For 5...20 seconds, you cannot be interrupted, but each time you would have been interrupted, you lose 1 Dervish enchantment or Pious Concentration ends.
conciseDescription: (5...20 seconds.) Prevents interrupts. <gray>Prevention cost: you lose one Dervish enchantment or Pious Concentration ends.</gray>

name: Pious Haste
description: You remove 1 Dervish enchantment and for 1...7 second[s] you move 25% faster. If an enchantment was removed you move 50% faster instead.
conciseDescription: (1...7 second[s].) Lose 1 Dervish enchantment and move 25% faster. Removal Effect: Run 50% faster instead.

name: Whirling Charge
description: For 1...6 second[s], you move 33% faster than normal. The next time you strike a foe, all other nearby foes take 10...50 cold damage and this enchantment ends.
conciseDescription: (1...6 second[s].) You move 33% faster. Deal 10...50 cold damage to all other nearby foes the next time you hit a foe and this enchantment ends.

name: Test of Faith
description: Deals 15...75 cold damage and takes 1 enchantment from target foe. If that foe was not enchanted, that foe is Dazed for 1...4 second[s].
conciseDescription: Touch Spell. Deals 15...75 cold damage and removes 1 enchantment. Target foe is Dazed for 1...4 second[s] if that foe was not enchanted.

name: Blazing Spear
description: If this attack hits, it deals +5...25 damage and sets target foe on Fire <sic/> for 1...3 second[s].
conciseDescription: Deals +5...25 damage. Inflicts Burning condition (1...3 second[s]).

name: Mighty Throw
description: Your spear moves three times faster. If it hits, you deal +10...40 damage.
conciseDescription: Deals +10...40 damage. This spear moves three times faster.

name: Cruel Spear
description: If this attack hits, you deal +10...50 damage. If it hits a non-moving target, you inflict a Deep Wound for 5...20 seconds.
conciseDescription: Deals +10...50 damage. Inflicts Deep Wound condition (5...20 seconds) if target is not moving.

name: Harrier's Toss
description: If this attack hits, you deal +5...20 damage. If this attack hits a moving foe, it deals an additional 5...40 damage.
conciseDescription: Deals +5...20 damage. Deals 5...40 more damage if target is moving.

name: Unblockable Throw
description: If this attack hits, you deal +10...40 damage. This attack cannot be blocked.
conciseDescription: Deals +10...40 damage. Unblockable.

name: Spear of Lightning
description: If this attack hits, it deals +8...20 lightning damage. This attack has 25% armor penetration.
conciseDescription: Deals +8...20 lightning damage. 25% armor penetration.

name: Wearying Spear
description: If this attack hits, you deal +10...40 damage. You are Weakened for 5 seconds.
conciseDescription: Deals +10...40 damage. <gray>You are Weakened (5 seconds).</gray>

name: Anthem of Fury
description: For 10 seconds, all party members within earshot gain 1...4 strikes of adrenaline the next time they use an attack skill.
conciseDescription: (10 seconds.) Party members in earshot gain 1...4 adrenaline with their next attack skill.

name: Crippling Anthem
description: For 10 seconds, the next attack skill used by each ally within earshot causes Crippling for 5...15 seconds.
conciseDescription: (10 seconds.) Allies in earshot inflict Crippled condition (5...15 seconds) with their next attack skill.

name: Defensive Anthem
description: For 4...10 seconds, each party member within earshot has a 50% chance to block incoming attacks. This chant ends if that party member hits with an attack skill.
conciseDescription: (4...10 seconds.) Party members in earshot have 50% chance to block. <gray>Ends when hitting with an attack skill.</gray>

name: Godspeed
description: For 5...20 seconds, all allies within earshot move 25% faster while under the effects of an enchantment.
conciseDescription: (5...20 seconds.) Allies in earshot move 25% faster while enchanted.

name: Anthem of Flame
description: For 10 seconds, the next attack skill used by each party member within earshot also causes Burning for 1...3 second[s].
conciseDescription: (10 seconds.) Party members in earshot inflict Burning condition (1...3 second[s]) with their next attack skill.

name: "Go for the Eyes!"
description: For 10 seconds, the next time each ally within earshot makes an attack, that attack has an additional 30...100% chance to critical.
conciseDescription: (10 seconds.) Allies in earshot have +30...100% to land a critical hit with their next attack.

name: Anthem of Envy
description: For 10 seconds, the next attack skill used by each ally within earshot deals +10...25 damage against foes with more than 50% Health.
conciseDescription: (10 seconds.) Allies in earshot do +10...25 damage with their next attack skill. <gray>Damage bonus only applies to foes with more than 50% Health.</gray>

name: Song of Power
description: For 5...20 seconds, each ally within earshot gains 4 Energy regeneration until that ally uses a Skill.
conciseDescription: (5...20 seconds.) Allies in earshot gain +4 Energy regeneration. <gray>Ends when using a skill.</gray>

name: Zealous Anthem
description: For 10 seconds, the next time each ally within earshot uses an attack skill, that ally gains 1...8 Energy.
conciseDescription: (10 seconds.) Allies in earshot gain 1...8 Energy with their next attack skill.

name: Aria of Zeal
description: For 10 seconds, the next time each ally within earshot uses a Spell, that ally gains 1...6 Energy.
conciseDescription: (10 seconds.) Allies in earshot gain 1...6 Energy with their next spell.

name: Lyric of Zeal
description: For 10 seconds, the next time each ally within earshot uses a signet, that ally gains 1...8 Energy.
conciseDescription: (10 seconds.) Allies in earshot gain 1...8 Energy with their next signet.

name: Ballad of Restoration
description: For 10 seconds, the next time each party member within earshot takes damage, that party member gains 15...75 Health.
conciseDescription: (10 seconds.) Party members in earshot gain 15...75 Health the next time they take damage.

name: Chorus of Restoration
description: For 10 seconds, the next time each ally within earshot uses a shout or chant, that ally is healed for 30...90 Health.
conciseDescription: (10 seconds.) Allies in earshot are healed for 30...90 with their next shout or chant.

name: Aria of Restoration
description: For 10 seconds, the next time each party member within earshot uses a spell, that party member gains 30...90 Health.
conciseDescription: (10 seconds.) Party members in earshot gain 30...90 Health with their next spell.

name: Song of Concentration
description: For 10 seconds, the next skill used by each ally within earshot cannot be interrupted.
conciseDescription: (10 seconds.) Allies in earshot are uninterruptible with their next skill.

name: Anthem of Guidance
description: For 10 seconds, the next attack skill used by each party member within earshot cannot be blocked.
conciseDescription: (10 seconds.) Party members in earshot are unblockable with their next attack skill.

name: Energizing Chorus
description: For 10 seconds, the next Shout or Chant used by each ally within earshot costs 3...7 less Energy.
conciseDescription: (10 seconds.) The next shout or chant costs 3...7 less Energy for allies within earshot.

name: Song of Purification
description: For 20 seconds, the next 1...6 skill[s] used by each ally within earshot remove 1 condition from that ally.
conciseDescription: (20 seconds.) Allies in earshot lose one condition with their next 1...6 skill[s].

name: Hexbreaker Aria
description: For 10 seconds, the next time each ally within earshot casts a spell, that ally loses 1 hex.
conciseDescription: (10 seconds.) Allies in earshot lose one hex with their next spell.

name: "Brace Yourself!"
description: For 5...15 seconds, the next time target other ally would be knocked down, all nearby foes take 15...75 damage instead.
conciseDescription: (5...15 seconds.) Prevents the next knock-down and deals 15...75 damage to all foes near target ally. <gray>Cannot self-target.</gray>

name: Awe
description: If this skill hits a knocked-down foe, that foe becomes Dazed for 5...15 seconds.
conciseDescription: Inflicts Dazed condition (5...15 seconds). <gray>No effect unless target is knocked-down.</gray>

name: Enduring Harmony
description: For 10...35 seconds, chants and shouts last 50% longer on target non-spirit ally.
conciseDescription: (10...35 seconds.) Chants and shouts last 50% longer on target ally. <gray>Cannot target spirits.</gray>

name: Blazing Finale
description: For 10...35 seconds, whenever a chant or shout ends on target non-spirit ally, all foes adjacent to that ally are set on Fire for 1...7 second[s].
conciseDescription: (10...35 seconds.) Inflicts Burning condition (1...7 second[s]) to adjacent foes whenever a chant or shout ends on target ally. <gray>Cannot target spirits.</gray>

name: Burning Refrain
description: For 20 seconds, if target non-spirit ally hits a foe with more Health than that ally, that foe is set on Fire <sic/> for 1...3 second[s]. This echo is reapplied every time a chant or shout ends on that ally.
conciseDescription: (20 seconds.) Inflicts Burning condition (1...3 second[s]) if target ally hits a foe with more Health. Renewal: Whenever a chant or shout ends on that ally. <gray>Cannot target spirits.</gray>

name: Finale of Restoration
description: For 10...35 seconds, whenever a chant or shout ends on target non-spirit ally, that ally is healed for 15...75 Health.
conciseDescription: (10...35 seconds.) Target ally gains <sic/> 15...75 Health whenever a shout or chant ends on that ally. <gray>Cannot target spirits.</gray>

name: Mending Refrain
description: For 15 seconds, target non-spirit ally has +2...3 Health regeneration. This echo is reapplied every time a chant or shout ends on that ally.
conciseDescription: (15 seconds.) Target ally has +2...3 Health regeneration. Renewal: whenever a chant or shout ends on that ally. <gray>Cannot target spirits.</gray>

name: Purifying Finale
description: For 10...35 seconds, target non-spirit ally loses 1 condition whenever a chant or shout ends on that ally.
conciseDescription: (10...35 seconds.) Target ally loses one condition whenever a chant or shout ends on that ally. <gray>Cannot target spirits.</gray>

name: Bladeturn Refrain
description: For 20 seconds, target non-spirit ally has a 5...20% chance to block incoming attacks. This echo is reapplied every time a chant or shout ends on that ally.
conciseDescription: (20 seconds.) Target ally has 5...20% chance to block. Renewal: Whenever a chant or shout ends on that ally. <gray>Cannot target spirits.</gray>

name: Glowing Signet
description: If target foe is Burning, you gain 5...15 Energy.
conciseDescription: You gain 5...15 Energy if target foe is Burning.

name: Leader's Zeal
description: For each nearby ally, you gain 2...4 Energy (maximum 8...12 Energy).
conciseDescription: You gain 2...4 Energy (maximum 8...12 Energy) for each nearby ally.

name: Leader's Comfort
description: You gain 30...75 Health. For each ally within earshot, you also gain +10...20 Health (maximum 140 Health).
conciseDescription: You gain 30...75 Health. You also gain 10...20 Health (maximum 140) for each ally in earshot.

name: Signet of Synergy
description: Target other ally is healed for 40...100 Health. If you are not under the effects of an enchantment, you are also healed for 40...100 Health.
conciseDescription: Heal target ally for 40...100. You are also healed for 40...100 if you are not enchanted. <gray>Cannot self-target.</gray>

name: Angelic Protection
description: For 10 seconds, any time target other ally takes more than 250...80 damage per second, that ally is healed for any damage over that amount.
conciseDescription: (10 seconds.) Each second that target ally takes damage over 250...80, that ally is healed for any damage over that amount. <gray>Cannot self target.</gray>

name: Angelic Bond
description: For 10 seconds, the next time an ally within earshot would take fatal damage, that damage is negated and that ally is healed for 20...200 Health. Angelic Bond ends on all other allies.
conciseDescription: (10 seconds.) The next time an ally within earshot would take fatal damage, that damage is negated and that ally is healed for 20...200. <gray>Ends on other allies.</gray>

name: Cautery Signet
description: All party members lose all conditions. You are set on Fire <sic/> for 1 second for each condition removed in this way.
conciseDescription: All party members lose all conditions. <gray>You begin Burning (one second for each condition removed).</gray>

name: "Stand Your Ground!"
description: For 5...20 seconds, all party members within earshot receive +24 armor when not moving.
conciseDescription: (5...20 seconds.) Party members in earshot gain +24 armor when not moving.

name: "Lead the Way!"
description: Target ally moves 25% faster for 1...5 seconds for each ally within earshot (maximum of 30 seconds).
conciseDescription: Target ally moves 25% faster for 1...5 seconds (maximum of 30 seconds) for each ally in earshot.

name: "Make Haste!"
description: For 5...20 seconds, target other ally moves 33% faster. This skill ends if that ally successfully hits with an attack.
conciseDescription: (5...20 seconds.) Target ally moves 33% faster. <gray>Ends if target ally hits with an attack. Cannot self-target.</gray>

name: "We Shall Return!"
description: All party members in earshot are resurrected with 25...50% Health and 5...20% Energy.
conciseDescription: All party members in earshot are resurrected (25...50% Health and 5...20% Energy).

name: "Never Give Up!"
description: All allies within earshot and below 75% Health gain 1...10 Energy.
conciseDescription: Allies in earshot gain 1...10 Energy. <gray>Only affects allies below 75% Health.</gray>

name: "Help!"
description: Target non-spirit ally gains 15...90 Health. For 1...10 seconds, other allies' spells targeting that ally cast 50% faster.
conciseDescription: (1...10 seconds.) Target non-spirit ally gains 15...90 health, allied spells targeting them cast 50% faster.

name: "Fall Back!"
description: For 4...10 seconds, all allies within earshot gain 5...15 Health per second while moving and move 33% faster. "Fall Back!" ends on an ally affected by this shout when that ally successfully hits with an attack.
conciseDescription: (4...10 seconds.) Allies in earshot gain 5...15 Health per second while moving and move 33% faster. <gray>Ends for an ally if that ally hits with an attack.</gray>

name: "Incoming!"
description: For 4...10 seconds, all allies within earshot move 33% faster, and gain 5...15 Health while moving.
conciseDescription: (4...10 seconds) Allies in earshot move 33% faster and gain 5...15 Health while moving.

name: "They're on Fire!"
description: For 10 seconds, party members within earshot take 5...35% less damage from foes suffering from Burning.
conciseDescription: (10 seconds.) Party members in earshot take 5...35% less damage from Burning foes.

name: "Never Surrender!"
description: For 15 seconds, all party members within earshot and below 75% Health gain +1...5 Health regeneration.
conciseDescription: (15 seconds.) Party members in earshot gain +1...5 Health regeneration. <gray>Only affects party members below 75% Health.</gray>

name: "It's Just a Flesh Wound."
description: Target other ally loses all conditions. If a condition was removed in this way, that ally moves 25% faster for 1...10 second[s].
conciseDescription: Remove all conditions from target ally. That ally moves 25% faster (1...10 second[s]) if a condition was removed. <gray>Cannot self-target.</gray>

name: Barbed Spear
description: If this attack hits, your target begins Bleeding for 5...20 seconds.
conciseDescription: Inflicts Bleeding condition (5...20 seconds).

name: Vicious Attack
description: If this attack hits, you deal +5...20 damage. If you land a critical hit with this attack, target foe suffers from a Deep Wound for 5...15 seconds.
conciseDescription: Deals +5...20 damage. Inflicts Deep Wound condition (5...15 seconds) with a critical hit.

name: Stunning Strike
description: If this attack hits, you deal +10...50 damage. If it hits a foe suffering from a condition, that foe is also Dazed for 4...10 seconds.
conciseDescription: Deals +10...50 damage. Inflicts Dazed condition (4...10 seconds) if target has a condition.

name: Merciless Spear
description: If this attack hits a foe with less than 50% Health, that foe suffers from a Deep Wound for 5...20 seconds.
conciseDescription: Inflicts Deep Wound condition (5...20 seconds). <gray>No effect unless target has less than 50% Health.</gray>

name: Disrupting Throw
description: If this attack hits a foe suffering from a condition, that foe is interrupted.
conciseDescription: Interrupts actions. <gray>No effect unless target has a condition.</gray>

name: Wild Throw
description: If this attack hits, it deals +5...20 damage, and any stance being used by your target ends. This attack cannot be blocked. All of your non-spear attack skills are disabled for 3 seconds.
conciseDescription: Deals +5...20 damage. Unblockable. Ends target's stance.<gray>Disables <sic/> your non-spear attack skills for 3 seconds.</gray>

name: Malicious Strike
description: If this attack hits a foe suffering from a condition, you deal +10...30 damage and this attack results in a critical hit.
conciseDescription: If target foe has a condition, this attack deals +10...30 damage and is a critical hit.

name: Shattering Assault
description: Must follow an off-hand attack. If it hits, you deal 5...50 damage and target foe loses one enchantment. This attack cannot be blocked.
conciseDescription: Deals 5...50 damage. Removes one enchantment. Unblockable. <gray>Must follow an off-hand attack.</gray>

name: Golden Skull Strike
description: If you are under the effects of an enchantment and this attack hits, target foe is Dazed 1...12 seconds.
conciseDescription: Inflicts Dazed condition (1...12 seconds). <gray>No effect unless you are enchanted.</gray>

name: Black Spider Strike
description: Must strike a hexed foe. If it hits, this attack strikes for +5...20 damage and target foe is Poisoned for 5...20 seconds.
conciseDescription: Deals +5...20 damage. Inflicts Poisoned condition (5...20 seconds). <gray>Must strike a hexed foe.</gray>

name: Golden Fox Strike
description: If this attack hits, target foe takes +10...30 damage. If you are under the effects of an Enchantment, this attack cannot be blocked.
conciseDescription: Deals +10...30 damage. Unblockable if you are Enchanted.

name: Deadly Haste
description: For 10...35 seconds, half-ranged spells cast 5...50% faster and recharge 5...60% faster.
conciseDescription: (10...35 seconds.) Your half-ranged spells cast 5...50% faster and recharge 5...60% faster.

name: Assassin's Remedy
description: For 30 seconds, the next 1...10 attack skills you use remove one condition.
conciseDescription: (30 seconds.) Your next 1...10 attack skills each remove one condition.

name: Fox's Promise
description: For 5...20 seconds, your dagger attacks cannot be blocked. This enchantment ends the next time you fail to hit.
conciseDescription: (5...20 seconds.) Your dagger attacks are unblockable. <gray>Ends the next time you fail to hit.</gray>

name: Feigned Neutrality
description: For 4...10 seconds, you have +7 Health regeneration and +80 armor. This enchantment ends if you successfully hit with an attack or use a skill.
conciseDescription: (4...10 seconds.) You have +7 Health regeneration and +80 armor. <gray>Ends if you hit with an attack or use a skill.</gray>

name: Hidden Caltrops
description: Your non-Assassin skills are disabled for 3 seconds. For 1...10 seconds, target foe moves 50% slower. When this hex ends that foe is Crippled for 1...15 seconds.
conciseDescription: (1...10 seconds.) Causes 50% slower movement. End effect: inflicts Crippled condition (1...15 seconds). Your non-Assassin skills are disabled (3 seconds.)

name: Assault Enchantments
description: Must follow a dual attack. Target foe loses all enchantments.
conciseDescription: Removes all enchantments. <gray>Must follow a dual attack.</gray>

name: Wastrel's Collapse
description: Shadow Step to target foe. If target foe is not using a skill, that foe is knocked down. All of your non-dagger attack skills are disabled for 10 seconds.
conciseDescription: Shadow Step to target foe. Causes knock-down if target foe is not using a skill. <gray>Disables your non-dagger attack skills (10 seconds).</gray>

name: Lift Enchantment
description: If target touched foe is knocked down, that foe loses one enchantment.
conciseDescription: Touch Skill. Removes one enchantment.<gray>No <sic/> effect unless target foe is knocked-down.</gray>

name: Augury of Death
description: For 5...35 seconds, the next time damage would drop target foe's Health below 50%, you inflict a Deep Wound for 5...20 seconds and Shadow Step to that foe. This spell has half the normal range.
conciseDescription: Half Range Hex Spell. (5...35 seconds.) Inflict Deep Wound condition (5...20 seconds) and Shadow Step to target foe the next time damage would drop this foe's Health below 50%.

name: Signet of Toxic Shock
description: If target foe is suffering from Poison, that foe takes 10...100 damage.
conciseDescription: Deals 10...100 damage. <gray>No effect unless target foe is Poisoned</gray>

name: Signet of Twilight
description: For each hex on target foe, that foe loses one enchantment.
conciseDescription: Removes one enchantment for each hex on target foe.

name: Way of the Assassin
description: For the next 20 seconds while wielding daggers, you attack 5...20% faster and have a +5...35% chance to land a critical hit.
conciseDescription: (20 seconds.) While wielding daggers, you attack 5...20% faster and have +5...35% chance to land a critical hit.

name: Shadow Walk
description: Shadow Step to target foe. For 15 seconds nothing happens. Your attack skills are disabled for 1 second, and your stances and enchantments are disabled for 10 seconds. When this stance ends, you return to your original location.
conciseDescription: (15 seconds.) Shadow Step to target foe. End effect: return to your original location. <gray>Disables your attack skills for 1 second. Disables your stances and enchantments for 10 seconds.</gray>

name: Death's Retreat
description: Shadow Step to target ally. If you have less Health than that ally, you gain 40...130 Health.
conciseDescription: Gain 40...130 Health if you have less Health than target ally. Initial effect: Shadow Step to this ally. <gray>Cannot self-target.</gray>

name: Shadow Prison
description: Shadow Step to target foe. For 1...7 seconds, that foe moves 66% slower.
conciseDescription: Shadow Step to target foe. This foe moves 66% slower (1...7 seconds).

name: Swap
description: You and target summoned creature Shadow Step to each other's location.
conciseDescription: You and target summoned creature Shadow Step to each other's locations.

name: Shadow Meld
description: Shadow Step to target other ally. When you stop maintaining this Enchantment, you return to your original location.
conciseDescription: Shadow Step to target ally. End effect: return to your original location. <gray>Cannot self-target.</gray>

name: Price of Pride
description: For 5 seconds, the next time target foe uses an elite skill, that foe loses 3...15 Energy.
conciseDescription: (5 seconds.) Causes 3...15 Energy loss the next time target foe uses an elite skill.

name: Air of Disenchantment
description: Remove one enchantment from target foe and all nearby foes. For 5...20 seconds, enchantments expire 150...300% faster on those foes.
conciseDescription: Also hexes foes near your target (5...20 seconds). Remove one enchantment from target and nearby foes. Enchantments expire 150...300% faster on those foes.

name: Signet of Clumsiness
description: If target foe is attacking, that foe and all adjacent foes are interrupted and take 15...60 damage. Any foes using attack skills are knocked down.
conciseDescription: Interrupts an attack for target foe and all adjacent foes. Interruption effect: deals 15...60 damage; knocks down foes using attack skills.

name: Symbolic Posture
description: For 5...20 seconds, the next signet you activate recharges 20...80% faster.
conciseDescription: (5...20 seconds.) Your next signet recharges 20...80% faster.

name: Toxic Chill
description: Target foe is struck for 15...75 cold damage. If that foe is under the effects of a hex or enchantment, that foe becomes Poisoned for 10...25 seconds.
conciseDescription: Deals 15...75 cold damage. Inflicts Poisoned condition (10...25 seconds) if target foe is hexed or enchanted.

name: Well of Silence
description: Exploit target corpse or sacrifice 66% health to create a Well of Silence for 10...30 seconds. Foes within the well cannot use shouts or chants and suffer -1...4 Health degeneration.
conciseDescription: (10...30 seconds.) Foes in this well cannot use shouts and chants and have -1...4 Health degeneration. <gray>Exploits a fresh corpse or sacrifices 66% health.</gray>

name: Glowstone
description: Send a projectile that strikes for 5...50 earth damage if it hits. If this spell hits a weakened <sic/> foe, you gain 5 Energy plus 1 Energy for every 2 ranks of Energy Storage.
conciseDescription: Projectile: deals 5...50 earth damage. You gain 5 Energy plus 1 Energy for every 2 ranks of Energy Storage if target foe is Weakened.

name: Mind Blast
description: Target foe is struck for 15...60 fire damage. If you have more Energy than target foe, you gain 1...8 Energy.
conciseDescription: Deals 15...60 fire damage. You gain 1...8 Energy if you have more Energy than target foe.

name: Elemental Flame
description: For 10...35 seconds, whenever you apply an Elemental hex to a foe, that foe is set on fire for 1...5 second[s].
conciseDescription: (10...35 seconds.) Inflicts Burning condition (1...5 second[s]) whenever you apply an Elemental hex to a target.

name: Invoke Lightning
description: Target foe and up to two other foes near your target are struck for 10...90 lightning damage. This spell has 25% armor penetration.
conciseDescription: Deals 10...90 lightning damage. Hits two foes near target. 25% armor penetration.

name: Pensive Guardian
description: For 5...11 seconds, target ally has a 50% chance to block attacks from enchanted foes.
conciseDescription: (5...11 seconds.) 50% chance to block enchanted foes.

name: Scribe's Insight
description: For 10...35 seconds, you gain 3 Energy whenever you use a Signet.
conciseDescription: (10...35 seconds.) You gain 3 Energy whenever you use a signet.

name: Holy Haste
description: For 1...60 second[s], your Healing Prayers spells cast 50% faster. This enchantment ends if you cast another enchantment.
conciseDescription: (1...60 second[s].) Your Healing Prayers spells cast 50% faster. <gray>Ends if you cast an enchantment.</gray>

name: Glimmer of Light
description: Heal target ally for 10...115 Health.
conciseDescription: Heals for 10...115.

name: Zealous Benediction
description: Heal target ally for 30...180 Health. If target was below 50% Health, you gain 7 Energy.
conciseDescription: Heals for 30...180. You gain 7 Energy if target ally was below 50% Health.

name: Defender's Zeal
description: For 5...25 seconds, whenever target foe hits with an attack, you gain 2 Energy.
conciseDescription: (5...25 seconds.) You gain 2 Energy whenever target foe hits with an attack.

name: Signet of Mystic Wrath
description: Target foe takes 25 holy damage for each enchantment on you (maximum 30...120 holy damage).
conciseDescription: Deals 25 holy damage for each enchantment on you (maximum 30...120 holy damage).

name: Signet of Removal
description: If target ally is under the effects of an enchantment, that ally loses one hex and one condition.
conciseDescription: Removes one hex and one condition. <gray>No effect unless target ally is enchanted.</gray>

name: Dismiss Condition
description: Remove one condition from target ally. If that ally is under the effects of an enchantment, that ally is healed for 15...75 Health.
conciseDescription: Removes one condition. Heals for 15...75 if target ally is enchanted.

name: Divert Hexes
description: Remove up to 1...3 hex[es] from target ally. For each hex removed in this way, that ally loses one condition and gains 15...75 Health.
conciseDescription: Removes 1...3 hex[es]. For each hex removed, target ally loses one condition and gains 15...75 Health.

name: Counterattack
description: If this attack hits, you strike for +5...35 damage. If you hit an attacking foe, you gain 2...6 Energy.
conciseDescription: Deals +5...35 damage. You gain 2...6 Energy if target foe is attacking.

name: Magehunter Strike
description: If this attack hits, you strike for +7...25 damage. If your target is under the effects of an enchantment, this attack cannot be blocked.
conciseDescription: Deals +7...25 damage. Unblockable if target foe is enchanted.

name: Soldier's Strike
description: If this attack hits, you deal +10...40 more damage. If you are under the effects of a chant or shout, this attack cannot be blocked.
conciseDescription: Deals +10...40 damage. Unblockable if you are under the effects of a chant or shout.

name: Decapitate
description: You lose all adrenaline and all Energy. If this attack hits, you deal +5...80 damage and cause a Deep Wound for 5...20 seconds. This attack always results in a critical hit.
conciseDescription: Deals +5...80 damage. Inflicts Deep Wound condition (5...20 seconds). Automatic critical hit. <gray>You lose all adrenaline and Energy.</gray>

name: Magehunter's Smash
description: If this attack hits, target foe is knocked down. If your target is under the effects of an enchantment, this attack cannot be blocked.
conciseDescription: Causes knock-down. Unblockable if target foe is enchanted.

name: Soldier's Stance
description: For 5...15 seconds, you have a 75% chance to block. You attack 33% faster while under the effects of a shout or chant.
conciseDescription: (5...15 seconds.) You have a 75% chance to block. You attack 33% faster while under the effects of a chant or shout.

name: Soldier's Defense
description: For 1...6 second[s], you have a 75% chance to block attacks while under the effects of a shout or chant. You gain 1 strike of adrenaline for each blocked attack.
conciseDescription: (1...6 second[s].) You have 75% chance to block while under the effects of a shout or chant. Block effect: gain 1 adrenaline.

name: Frenzied Defense
description: For 8 seconds, you have a 75% chance to block incoming attacks, but take double damage.
conciseDescription: (8 seconds.) You have 75% chance to block. <gray>You take double damage.</gray>

name: Steady Stance
description: For 10 seconds, the next time you would be knocked down, you gain 1...4 strike[s] of adrenaline and 1...7 Energy instead.
conciseDescription: (10 seconds.) The next time you would be knocked-down, you gain 1...4 adrenaline and 1...7 Energy instead.

name: Steelfang Slash
description: If this attack hits, you deal +1...31 damage. If you hit a foe that is knocked down, you gain 1...5 adrenaline.
conciseDescription: Deals +1...31 damage. You gain 1...5 adrenaline if target foe is knocked down.

name: Screaming Shot
description: If this attack hits, you deal +10...25 damage. If your target is within earshot, that foe begins Bleeding for 5...20 seconds.
conciseDescription: Deals +10...25 damage. Inflicts Bleeding condition (5...20 seconds) if target foe is within earshot.

name: Keen Arrow
description: If this attack hits, you strike for +5...20 damage. If you land a critical hit, you deal an additional +5...25 damage.
conciseDescription: Deals +5...20 damage. Deals +5...25 more damage if you land a critical hit.

name: Rampage as One
description: For 3...15 seconds, both you and your animal companion attack 33% faster and run 25% faster.
conciseDescription: (3...15 seconds.) You and your pet attack 33% faster and move 25% faster. <gray>No effect unless your pet is alive.</gray>

name: Forked Arrow
description: Shoot two arrows simultaneously at target foe. If you are under the effects of an enchantment or hex, you shoot only one arrow.
conciseDescription: You shoot two arrows simultaneously. <gray>Shoot only one arrow if you are enchanted or hexed.</gray>

name: Disrupting Accuracy
description: For 36 seconds, whenever your arrows critical, they also interrupt your target.
conciseDescription: (36 seconds.) Interrupts an action whenever your arrows critical.

name: Expert's Dexterity
description: For 1...20 second[s], you attack 33% faster and your Marksmanship attribute is increased by 2.
conciseDescription: (1...20 second[s].) You attack 33% faster and you gain +2 to your Marksmanship attribute.

name: Roaring Winds
description: Create a level 1...10 spirit. Chants and shouts cost 1...5 more Energy. This spirit dies after 30...180 seconds.
conciseDescription: Creates a level 1...10 spirit (30...180 second lifespan). Chants and shouts cost 1...5 more Energy for creatures in range.

name: Magebane Shot
description: If this attack hits, it interrupts target foe's action. If that action was a spell, it is disabled for an additional 10 seconds. This attack cannot be blocked.
conciseDescription: Interrupts an action. Interruption effect: an interrupted spell is disabled for +10 seconds. Unblockable.

name: Natural Stride
description: For 1...8 second[s], you run 33% faster and have a 50% chance to block incoming attacks. Natural Stride ends if you become hexed or enchanted.
conciseDescription: (1...8 second[s].) You move 33% faster and have 50% chance to block. <gray>Ends if you become hexed or enchanted.</gray>

name: Heket's Rampage
description: For 5...11 seconds, you attack 33% faster. This stance ends if you use an attack skill.
conciseDescription: (5...11 seconds). You attack 33% faster. <gray>Ends if you use an attack skill.</gray>

name: Smoke Trap
description: When Smoke Trap is triggered, nearby foes are Blinded and Dazed for 5...10 seconds. Smoke Trap ends after 90 seconds. While activating this skill, you are easily interrupted.
conciseDescription: (90 seconds.) Inflicts Blinded and Dazed conditions (5...10 seconds) to nearby foes. <gray>Easily interrupted.</gray>

name: Infuriating Heat
description: Create a level 1...10 spirit. Non-spirit creatures within its range gain adrenaline twice as fast. This spirit dies after 30...120 seconds.
conciseDescription: Creates a level 1...10 spirit (30...120 second lifespan). Doubles adrenaline gain for creatures in range.

name: Vocal Was Sogolon
description: For 60 seconds, all shouts and chants you use last 20...50% longer.
conciseDescription: (60 seconds.) Shouts and chants you use last 20...50% longer.

name: Destructive Was Glaive
description: Hold Glaive's ashes for up to 30...60 seconds. While you hold her ashes, all Ritualist skills have 20% armor penetration. When you drop her ashes, all foes in the area are struck for 15...85 lightning damage.
conciseDescription: (30...60 seconds.) Your Ritualist skills have 20% armor penetration. Drop effect: deals 15...85 lightning damage to all foes in the area.

name: Wielder's Strike
description: Target foe is struck for 5...50 lightning damage. If you are under the effects of a weapon spell, you deal an additional 10...40 lightning damage.
conciseDescription: Deals 5...50 lightning damage. Deals 10...40 more lightning damage if you are under a weapon spell.

name: Gaze of Fury
description: Destroy target spirit and create a level 1...14 Spirit of Fury. This spirit's attacks deal 5...20 damage. This spirit dies after 30...60 seconds.
conciseDescription: Destroys a spirit. Creates a level 1...14 spirit (30...60 second lifespan). Its attacks deal 5...20 damage.

name: Spirit's Strength
description: For 15...60 seconds, your attacks deal 5...35 more damage while under the effects of a weapon spell.
conciseDescription: (15...60 seconds.) Your attacks deal +5...35 damage if you are under a weapon spell.

name: Wielder's Zeal
description: For 10...40 seconds, whenever you cast a Weapon Spell on an ally, you gain 1...5 Energy.
conciseDescription: (10...40 seconds.) You gain 1...5 Energy whenever you cast a weapon spell.

name: Sight Beyond Sight
description: For 8...20 seconds, you cannot be Blinded.
conciseDescription: (8...20 seconds). You are immune to Blindness.

name: Renewing Memories
description: For 5...20 seconds, while holding an item, any weapon and item Spells you cast cost 5...35% less Energy.
conciseDescription: (5...20 seconds.) Your weapon and item spells cost 5...35% less Energy. <gray>No effect unless holding an item.</gray>

name: Wielder's Remedy
description: For 10...30 seconds, whenever you cast a weapon spell on an ally, that ally loses 2 conditions.
conciseDescription: (10...30 seconds.) Whenever you cast a weapon spell, the targeted ally loses two conditions.

name: Ghostmirror Light
description: Target other ally is healed for 15...90 Health. If you are within earshot of a spirit, you are also healed for 15...90 Health.
conciseDescription: Heals for 15...90. You gain 15...90 Health if you are within earshot of a spirit. <gray>Cannot self-target.</gray>

name: Signet of Ghostly Might
description: For 5...20 seconds, all spirits you control within earshot attack 33% faster and deal 5...10 additional damage.
conciseDescription: (5...20 seconds.) All spirits you control within earshot attack 33% faster and deal +5...10 damage.

name: Signet of Binding
description: You lose 200...50 Health and take control of target enemy-controlled spirit. (50% failure chance with Spawning Power 4 or less.)
conciseDescription: You lose 200...50 Health. Gain control of target enemy-controlled spirit. <gray>50% failure chance unless Spawning Power 5 or more.</gray>

name: Caretaker's Charge
description: Target foe is struck for 20...75 lightning damage. If you are holding an item, you gain 5 Energy and 5...50 Health.
conciseDescription: Deals 20...75 lightning damage. You gain 5 Energy and 5...50 Health if you are holding an item.

name: Anguish
description: Create a level 1...11 spirit. This spirit's attacks deal 5...20 damage and deal double damage to hexed foes. This spirit dies after 15...45 seconds.
conciseDescription: Creates a level 1...11 spirit (15...45 second lifespan). Its attacks deal 5...20 damage. Double damage to hexed foes.

name: Empowerment
description: Create a level 1...14 spirit. All allies within its range holding an item gain 15...45 maximum Health and 10 maximum Energy. This spirit dies after 15...60 seconds.
conciseDescription: Creates a level 1...14 spirit (15...60 second lifespan). Allies in range holding an item gain 15...45 maximum Health and 10 maximum Energy.

name: Recovery
description: Create a level 1...14 spirit. Conditions on allies within range of this spirit expire 20...50% faster. This spirit dies after 30...60 seconds.
conciseDescription: Creates a level 1...14 spirit (30...60 second lifespan). Conditions on allies in range expire 20...50% faster.

name: Weapon of Fury
description: For 5...20 seconds, target ally gains 100% more adrenaline and 1 Energy whenever that ally successfully hits with an attack.
